subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should embedded hooks receive a current-session-only deferred reset request, or a general caller-keyed immediate session-reset API?
rationale: This adds a privileged shared plugin API, and the permanent target and execution semantics cannot safely be inferred from the proposed implementation because immediate reset conflicts with the active-run lifecycle.

options.title: Current-session deferred reset
options.body: Derive the target from trusted hook context and execute the reset after the current run exits, avoiding arbitrary targeting and self-wait.

options.title: General reset API
options.body: Allow caller-selected keys only with explicit authorization, re-entrancy semantics, compatibility documentation, and proof for active and inactive targets.

options.title: Keep hooks observational
options.body: Do not add a reset API and move reset policy to the core compaction orchestrator instead.

recommendation.title: Current-session deferred reset
recommendation.body: Derive the target from trusted hook context and execute the reset after the current run exits, avoiding arbitrary targeting and self-wait.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice governs compaction and context-engine lifecycle behavior in the area assigned to this owner.
